# graviteeam_email_template (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM Email Template (custom email content for registration confirmation, password reset, etc.)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_email_template" "example" {
  domain_id     = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  template      = "REGISTRATION_CONFIRMATION"
  enabled       = true
  from          = "noreply@example.com"
  from_name     = "My App"
  subject       = "Confirm your registration"
  content       = "<html><body>Click to confirm: ${token}</body></html>"
  expires_after = 86400
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The HTML content of the email (supports FreeMarker expressions)
- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain this email template belongs to
- `expires_after` (Number) Token/link validity duration in seconds (e.g. 86400 for 24 hours)
- `from` (String) Sender email address
- `subject` (String) Email subject line
- `template` (String) The email template type (e.g. REGISTRATION_CONFIRMATION, RESET_PASSWORD, BLOCKED_ACCOUNT, MFA_CHALLENGE)

### Optional

- `application_id` (String) The ID of the application (for app-level override). If not set, the email template applies at domain level.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the custom email template is enabled
- `from_name` (String) Sender display name

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the email template
